root_causes.evidence: File was -r--r--r--; POST /orders failed with sqlite3.OperationalError: attempt to write a readonly database while health/catalog passed.

report.summary: Checkout returned 500 because data/shop.db was read-only. I made it writable with set_file_writable, and all 5 smoke tests now pass, including checkout with the order persisted. The payments ledger shows two charges (pay_656588394b at 19:32:14 and pay_583aebf2f8 at 19:32:17) that match the failed checkout attempts, which have no saved orders. They are probably smoke-test charges, but a human should confirm and refund them if they were real customers.
